items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Once Billy gave me some music... Billy would tell me... sometimes he’d play piano with us

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you get to witness Duke collaborating with Strayhorn much?

Yeah. I’ve seen him come in and collaborate, preparing for a television show. They would talk around the piano. And I’ve seen them talk during recording sessions. Once Billy gave me some music and it was just measures and no notes. No chord changes. “Oh just play what you hear.” Yeah. Play what you hear. I’ve seen that. A lot of times they didn’t write anything for the bass.
That seems amazing to me. Because I mean that’s where it all starts.
